criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Right register, one low left key; 2, 1, 9 hold and 5 is a real relief. Frame 3's pack reads as a brown timber crate beside a mannequin; 4 a brown bar chart; 7's lower half an empty slab and its converging rows can't be compared at thumb size; 8's subject under a fifth of the frame; 6's lit caliche mid fraction 0.166.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One site at last light, one light and grade, the ember line on 1, 6, 7 and 9, a declared camera move and value cut; frame 8 sits slightly outside; 1 and 9 read as bookends.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The first comment described a second trench no frame draws and a cooling N/A share the fact check rejected as unquotable. Slide 6's universal is an inference past c18's quote resting on the computed rate rank.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when are named; the so what is never said; water (c36) and the December 17th meeting (c38) were verified and unused; jargon unexplained.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe for a following reader; 2 pays at once; the turn lands at 5 to 7; 3 repeats the cover's 177 GW; 8 is a cuttable detour; the close is a date.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and within house rules but a careful paraphrase of ERCOT; West Texas the only regional touch; the caption's closing question is good.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh concept with repeated moves: lastLight caliche, empty bolted pads, a gate close, a copper bus bar, the hi-vis worker; no. 60 covered the same RFI at issue.

hard_fails: An unverified fact presented as verified in the published first comment: 'The second trench stands for the cooling questions alone, grated for the share not answered N/A, from the same tables, c18' describes a drawing no frame contains and a cooling N/A share the fact check rejected.
one_sentence_fix: Replace the Batch Zero detour on frame 8 with the stake and the action, water (c36) and the December 17th meeting (c38).

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The pack reads as a brown timber crate with a flat orange end face; the worker a mannequin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Metallic copper raked by the low key across the striped end face, stripes across the visible end, the worker on the shadow side three-quarter back.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An empty mid-tone slab in the lower half, a bolt cut at the footer, converging rows that can't be compared at thumb size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter view down two parallel rows across the lower two-thirds with the extra stubs past the shorter row; crop the empty slab and the footer bolt.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Table, figure and stack under a fifth of the frame in a dark bay; the official a mannequin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in until the table and stack fill a third to half the width, light the stack as the brightest edge, the figure in profile in shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Four packs read as wooden cabinets under floating labels, a brown bar chart.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Frame 3's copper, a 0.6 m eye raking every lamination edge, labels as tags on the dunnage.
